title: A study to compare heart failure medicines in one combined pill with usual care.
official: A multinational, multicenter, prospective, randomized, open-label, event-driven trial with two parallel arms, to compare the efficacy and safety of Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT) with the use of Fixed-Dose Combination (FDC) strategy versus usual care for the management of Heart Failure.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate in participants admitted for acute HF the effect of treatment delivered as FDC (Fixed-dose combination) based strategy compared to usual care on HFE (Heart Failure Event) and cardiovascular death

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult men or women of any ethnic origin aged at least 18 years old to no more than 85 years old.
2. Signed written informed consent to participate in the study.
3. Hospitalization for the primary diagnosis of acute HF with dyspnea (at rest or exacerbated exertional) and at least two of the other signs/symptoms of decompensated HF (such as peripheral edema, rales on auscultation, pulmonary congestion on chest X-ray, elevated jugular venous pressure [JVP]) at admission.
4. Elevated natriuretic peptide from admission to inclusion, N-terminal pro-B-type Natriuretic Peptide (NT-proBNP) ≥ 1600 pg/mL or B-Type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP) ≥ 400 pg/mL. Patients with atrial fibrillation: NT-proBNP ≥ 2400 pg/mL or BNP ≥ 600 pg/mL.
5. Hemodynamically stable* participants included between 48 hours and 10 days after admission.  *This term excludes any vasoactive intravenous vasopressors, inotropes, vasodilators, and IV diuretics  within the last 24h before inclusion
6. No contraindications to SGLT2i (Sodium-GLucose co-Transporter-2 inhibitor), BB (Beta-Blocker) and MRA (Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonist) at inclusion.
7. Systolic blood pressure (SBP) ≥ 100 mmHg and/or heart rate (HR) ≥ 60 bpm at inclusion.
8. Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 50% documented on the last assessment within the last 12 months before inclusion.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus
2. Serum potassium (K+) < 3.2 mmol/L or > 5.0 mmol/L at inclusion
3. Serum sodium (Na+) <130 mmol/L or >150 mmol/L at inclusion
4. Renal disease with estimated glomerular filtration rate eGFR ≤ 30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (as estimated by the simplified Modification of Diet in Renal Disease [MDRD] formula at inclusion, or history of dialysis.
